all_found.desc: [ADVISORY] PathsSince's `git diff --name-only` honours diff.ignoreSubmodules / .gitmodules ignore=all, so a submodule pointer bump can be missing from the path list. A gitlink-only commit could carry the marker where config hides submodule changes.

[ADVISORY] Only pr-ready has an end-to-end marker-carry test; the task-done and epic-ready call sites switched to CurrentReviewEvidence are untested. Reverting either call site to LatestReviewEvidence leaves every test green, so the #161 carry could silently regress for those gates.

[ADVISORY] Any docs/metareview/fsm/**/workflow.yaml counts as a gate artifact, and `fsm init --workflow <path>` can load an arbitrary path. A hand-written workflow.yaml can ride a marker; loading it with commands still needs --allow-custom-cmds consent.

[BUG] validateFromRunDiff trusts the head stamped on the final clean/reviewed transition, which is only git's HEAD when that transition fired, not the head the lenses reviewed. discover at H1, commit unreviewed code H2, adjudicate -> done(clean) stamps H2; record-lenses --from-run then accepts a subagent-adjudicated marker for H2 over code no lens saw.

findings.issue_text: [BUG] lensesReviewedFinalHead requires a review-lenses needs_input at the final head, but real sdlc-loop-clean runs often record the recheck/discover node_output without a needs_input (the driver supplies it at an unchanged head), so their genuine clean fix head is refused. About 5 of ~22 real sdlc-loop-clean runs ending clean at a fix head are rejected by record-lenses --from-run and must fall back to in-session-emulated. Replayed over the 71 runs in the store.
[ADVISORY] No test isolates the review-head guard; the laundered test is rejected by the later transition loop first. Disabling the review-head check leaves the suite green.
[ADVISORY] lensesReviewedFinalHead hard-codes workflow.yaml instead of machine.SidecarWorkflow. A sidecar rename would silently make the check fail closed.

rejected.desc: [BUG] gateArtifactExts allows only .md/.json/.jsonl, but every FSM export bundle under docs/metareview/fsm/<run>/ also contains workflow.yaml (all 63 committed bundles do), so IsGateArtifact is false for it. Committing a real `fsm export` bundle after record-lenses still strands the marker — the exact #161 failure — for every flow that commits FSM bundles.

[ADVISORY] AGENTS.md's second paragraph still says to re-record after any new commit and that --from-run's run must record the same base..head in its init. AGENTS.md contradicts itself and CLAUDE.md/ARCHITECTURE on #161 and mr-1ad.

[ADVISORY] CurrentReviewEvidence checks every older same-base marker head (two git calls each) though only the last eligible marker matters. About 2N git calls per gate on a long-lived branch with N stale markers; slow under a stalled git.

rejected.desc: [ADVISORY] The edited CLAUDE.md sentence leaves '(it cannot be hand-typed to fake independent review)' dangling after an em-dash clause on an over-long line. The durable completion rule reads as if the parenthetical qualifies the mr-1ad head rule.

[ADVISORY] Under the newest-first scan a later-recorded marker at an ancestor head (differing only by gate artifacts) beats an earlier exact-head marker. A rare reset-and-re-review sequence can let an older head's verdict decide HEAD; errs conservative for NEEDS_REVISION.

rejected.desc: [ADVISORY] The task-done carry test has no negative control (a code commit invalidating the marker). A task-done carry that ignored code commits would not be caught.

[ADVISORY] The from-run tests cover only clean and fixed endings, not reviewed nor the workflow constraint on a final-head match. A dropped reviewed arm or a reordered workflow check would not be caught.
[ADVISORY] LatestReviewEvidence has no production caller left and duplicates CurrentReviewEvidence's selection loop. The two loops can drift.
[ADVISORY] Two code comments still describe --from-run as init-head-only. Maintainers read the pre-mr-1ad contract.
